commands.description: Diagnose local Tier0 CLI connectivity and auth

flags.description: Print the authorization URL and exit without polling

flags.name: --setup-code
flags.description: Poll for an existing setup code instead of creating a new one

notes: Without --no-wait, the CLI polls every 5 seconds for up to 10 minutes.
With --no-wait --json, the CLI returns verification_url, setup_code, and expires_in.

commands.description: Upload a file to Tier0 object storage

flags.name: --concurrency
flags.description: Multipart upload concurrency (number of parallel parts)

flags.name: --abort
flags.description: Abort an interrupted multipart upload and clean up its state

notes: Exactly one local file argument is required.
Files larger than 100MB automatically use multipart upload.
The CLI does not enforce a hard maximum file size; the server applies plan/quota limits.
